title: A Restaurant Review
text:
Last week, Maria wrote a review of a small Italian restaurant in her town. She said the pasta was very good and the waiter was friendly. However, she thought the room was too noisy.

She gave the restaurant four stars out of five. Her review also said that the prices were fair. Many people read reviews before they choose a place to eat, so Maria wanted to be honest.

questions.text: What did Maria think about the pasta?
How many stars did Maria give the restaurant?
Why did Maria want to be honest in her review?
options: Because she wanted to help people who might choose the restaurant
Because she was angry with the waiter
Because the restaurant asked her to write it
Because she does not like pasta

questions.text: What can we guess about the restaurant from Maria's review?
options: It is a good place to eat, but the room could be quieter
It does not serve any food

vocabulary.definition: a written opinion about a place, product or service
reasonable, not too high in price

paragraph_translations: Geçen hafta Maria, kasabasındaki küçük bir İtalyan restoranı hakkında bir değerlendirme yazdı. Makarnanın çok iyi olduğunu ve garsonun arkadaş canlısı olduğunu söyledi. Ancak odanın çok gürültülü olduğunu düşündü.

Restorana beşte dört yıldız verdi. Değerlendirmesinde fiyatların adil olduğunu da belirtti. Birçok insan nerede yemek yiyeceğine karar vermeden önce yorumları okur, bu yüzden Maria dürüst olmak istedi.
